svg.aria-label: ishioho crossing compact night floor plan with balcony on the left
svg.metadata: ishioho crossing; compact 1400 by 700 clockwise floorplan. Balcony is the planted room at the left, matched to the original plant-and-bench room. Entry occupies the other lower room from the original. Stair treads restored at the original angled landing between balcony and entry; garage popup belongs here. No detached garage artwork. Weather, moon phase, room controls and robot state are supplied by parent dashboard. Decorative terrain is illustrative. Animations respect prefers-reduced-motion. No external dependencies.
